# What will this company car cost me in tax?

> Free UK company car tax calculator for 2026/27: benefit in kind for electric, plug-in hybrid and petrol or diesel cars, monthly tax at your rate, employer Class 1A, free-fuel charge, the 4% to 9% electric schedule to 2029/30 and a side-by-side with a second car. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
